### `MapPairsReduce(UF, UF)`
Creates a `MapPairsReduce` instance with the supplied user functions. To specify the amount of vertical or horizontal input `Vector`s, you do so as template parameters when creating the `MapPairsReduce` instance, such as `skepu::MapPairsReduce<3, 2>(UF)` which would take 3 vertical and 2 horizontal input `Vector`s.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int mult(int a, int b)
{
    return a * b;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce(mult, sum);
}
```

### `operator()`
Calls the `MapPairsReduce` instance, performing the first user function on the input `Vector`s, and storing the result in the corresponding location in the intermediate `Matrix`. Afterwards, the second user function is performed on the `Matrix`, performing a 1D reduction to the output `Vector`. The vertical input `Vector`s are passed after the output `Matrix`, and the horizontal input `Vector`s are passed after the vertical input `Vector`s.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int mult(int v1, int v2, int h)
{
    return v1 * v2 * h;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    const int vSize = 3;
    const int hSize = 7;
    skepu::Vector<int> v1(vSize), v2(vSize), h(hSize), res(vSize);

    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce<2, 1>(mult, sum);

    mpr(res, v1, v2, h);
}
```

### `setStartValue(T)`
Sets the start value that the reduction will start on for each row or column in the `Reduce` phase. By default it is set to `T{}`, the default initialization of the type.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int mult(int a, int b)
{
    return a * b;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce(mult, sum);
    mpr.setStartValue(10);
}
```

### `setReduceMode(ReduceMode)`
Sets the reduce mode of the `Reduce` phase. Can either be set to `ReduceMode::RowWise` or `ReduceMode::ColWise`. Is set to `ReduceMode::RowWise` by default.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int mult(int a, int b)
{
    return a * b;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce(mult, sum);
    mpr.setReduceMode(skepu::ReduceMode::ColWise);
}
```

### `setDefaultSize(size_t i, size_t j)`
Sets the default size to be used in each dimension which will be used when one of the dimensions has 0 input `Vector`s. Is set to 1 in both dimensions by default.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int mult(int a, int b)
{
    return a * b;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce(mult, sum);
    mpr.setDefaultSize(2, 2);
}
```

:::{#lst-mappairsreduce}
```cpp
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int mult(int a, int b)
{
    return a * b;
}

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    const int vSize = 3;
    const int hSize = 7;
    skepu::Vector<int> v(vSize), h(hSize, 2), res(hSize);

    skepu::external(skepu::read(v, h), [&](){
	    for (int i = 0; i < v.size_i(); ++i)
			v(i) = i + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < h.size_i(); ++i)
			h(i) = i + 1;
	}, skepu::write(v, h));

    auto mpr = skepu::MapPairsReduce(mult, sum);
    mpr.setReduceMode(skepu::ReduceMode::ColWise);

    mpr(res, v, h);

    skepu::io::cout << res << "\n"; // Prints 7.... 6 12 18 24 30 36 42
}
```
Example usage of the `MapPairsReduce` skeleton.
